question: The fewest NAE knots that make a harmony or a counter with two distinctions per position, flat and hopping reach, and their weight under short descriptions.

definitions.variants: flat (old i-1, i, i+1; new i-1, i) and hop (old i, old floor(i/2); new i-1, i), two distinctions per position
definitions.rules: all with 1-2 knots; 4,000 per variant with 3-30 knots drawn by the code
definitions.classes: constant; eventually constant; harmony (p 2-10 from a <= 20); unexplained

public_inputs.run: census.py --all V W 8 for V in flat, hop and W in 0-7; --sample V W 500 for W in 0-7; then --summary, from the repository root.

forbidden_inputs: Changing the variants, rules, readings, classes, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
primary_observable: Rules with a harmony or an unexplained sequence; fewest knots; weight shares.
stop_rule: One run and its summary; a hand-off to the referee thread; report; pause.
